name: Artificial Agency
tagline: A generative behavior engine for living game characters.
description: Artificial Agency's behavior engine uses foundation models to turn game systems into autonomous agents at runtime — characters that remember player interactions and personalize encounters, plus 'game director' systems that adapt story and pacing. Studios integrate it into any genre without game-specific training, keeping their existing tools and workflows. The engine launched in alpha to select studios via a pilot program.
insight: Founded 2023 in Edmonton by ex-DeepMind researchers; emerged from stealth in 2024 with $16M from Radical Ventures and Toyota Ventures.
edge: A dedicated runtime behavior engine — drops generative NPCs and adaptive game directors into any genre, with no game-specific model training.
pros: Generative NPCs that remember and personalize
Team & backers from DeepMind and AAA studios
cons: Alpha — limited to select studios via pilot
No public pricing or self-serve access
Runtime LLM behavior raises latency/cost questions

references.title: Artificial Agency launches Behavior Engine to create games that feel 'alive'
